explanation_full: The provided scatter plot visualizes the relationship between actual and predicted values for the Decision Tree model.  The R2 score of 0.56 indicates a moderate fit to the data, meaning that approximately 56% of the variance in the target variable can be explained by the model. The RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error) of 0.1755 and MAE (Mean Absolute Error) of 0.1086 quantify the average magnitude of errors made by the model. While these values are not exceptionally high, they suggest that there is still room for improvement in the model's predictive accuracy. Further analysis of the scatter plot can reveal patterns or outliers that may contribute to these errors and guide potential model refinements.
